Original: My Version:

1 cup corn meal 1 cup stone ground Hopi blue corn meal (lower carb, higher protein) 1 cup flour 1/2 cup whole wheat flour (I like coarse ground best) 1 t salt 1/2 cup gluten flour or vital wheat gluten (lower carb, higher protein) 5 t baking powder 1 t sea salt 1/4 cup sugar 5 t baking powder 1 egg the equivalent to 1/4 cup sugar (I use Stevia) 1 cup milk 2 eggs 1/4 cup fat 1 cup whole milk 1/4 cup olive oil

This works best if you have a well seasoned (broken in) 10 in cast iron skillet to bake in but I have used a regular cake pan and got satisfactory results. First pour the oil into the skillet and put it in the oven as you preheat the oven to 350 deg. Next put the dry ingredients into a large bowl and mix well. Then add the milk and eggs and mix well. You may need to add a bit more milk to get everything good and moist. After the oven has preheated to 350 deg. carefully remove the skillet and slowly pour the hot oil into the mixing bowl and slowly mix it into the batter. Be very careful here as the hot oil really has a tendency to splash out if you get in a hurry! Next pour the batter into the hot skillet and place in the middle rack and bake at 350 deg for about 35 minutes. Serve buttered.
